mission: Verify ACTUAL live prices for every domain Sprint 10 recommended as cheap
methodology: WHOIS lookups (registry + registrar level expiry comparison)
DNS A record resolution to identify parking/aftermarket IPs
HTTP landing page analysis (LANDER_SYSTEM type, Sedo/Moniker ERRP pages)
Afternic API JSON extraction (buyNowPrice, minPrice, sellable status)
EPP status code analysis (clientRenewProhibited = auction indicator)
Registrar vs Registry expiry date discrepancy analysis

executive_summary.sprint10_pricing_accuracy: 3 out of 10 domains had COMPLETELY WRONG pricing
executive_summary.critical_finding: Sprint 10 confused GoDaddy Aftermarket/Premium (Afternic) listings with GoDaddy Closeout. rbiwoodtools.com ($5 claimed) is actually $1,500+ Make Offer. shrimpvietnam.com ($5 claimed) is $2,022 Buy Now on Afternic. sobsuan.com ($5 claimed) is $300+ Make Offer on Afternic. The 'expired auction' domains (chapter7bankruptcy, flashcardsonline, freeexercise, freetail, lifebetter, sageinvestor) have genuinely expired at their registrars in April 2026 and are likely in the GoDaddy/Tucows/eNom auction or closeout pipeline, but their CURRENT auction prices cannot be verified from outside the GoDaddy Auctions platform (requires authenticated login).

process_improvements: ALWAYS check WHOIS registrar before claiming domain is on GoDaddy Auctions - only GoDaddy-registered domains appear there
ALWAYS compare registry expiry vs registrar expiry to detect expired domains
ALWAYS check Afternic API (buyNowPrice, sellable, minPrice) to detect aftermarket pricing
NEVER assume a domain on a GoDaddy parking page is a closeout - the same parking lander serves both $5 closeouts and $50,000 aftermarket domains
Look for clientRenewProhibited EPP status as the definitive indicator of GoDaddy auction/expiry processing
